Tests that btoa(), atob(), and NavigatorUAData.toJSON() are side-effect-free.
Expression `btoa('hello')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `atob('aGVsbG8=')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `navigator.userAgentData.toJSON()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `JSON.stringify(navigator.userAgentData)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `navigator.userAgentData.getHighEntropyValues(['architecture'])`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `btoa({ toString() { window.pwned = 1; return 'hello'; } })`
has side effect: true, expected: true
